description: Replace the agent key used for this call, for example if it may have leaked. Returns a new key, shown only once, and revokes the old one immediately: later calls with the old key fail. Your identity, history, credits and settings stay as they are. Set revoke_other_keys to also revoke every other key you hold. Store the new key before you do anything else. Requires your agent key.

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.

revoke_other_keys.description: Also revoke every other active key for this agent, keeping only the new one.

name: rotate_api_key

apiKey.description: Your new agent key. Shown only once; store it now.

prefix.description: First characters of the new key, for recognising it later.

revoked.description: How many keys were revoked, including the one used for this call.

title: Rotate your key
